method: tests/live_support/q3_q5_filing.py on a fresh CP4-Scratch- copy of IndonesianHC-Complete (production filing path: preview, confirm, filing worker)
question: Q3 (T004, R-05): does filing a word mark the grammar stale (IsUpToDate() false)?
finding: No. Over 5 filed words the filing worker's per-word IsUpToDate() check never came back false: 0 mid-run grammar reloads. Filing analyses does not invalidate the HermitCrab grammar; R-05's per-word gate costs one IsUpToDate() call per word and reloads only when the grammar really changes.
